name: Base Jumper
description: Updates BaseOS on Anbernic RG XX devices and the Miyoo Flip over WiFi.
author: SundownerSport

changelog.v1.1.0: Supports BaseOS for the Miyoo Flip (my355).
changelog.v1.0.3: Long messages no longer split mid-line.
changelog.v1.0.2: No longer hangs on the checking screen. Tells you when WiFi is off or the date is wrong. Safer download.
